boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Redlands, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence that starts on campus, builds in connection and local exploration, and ends with a seasonal evening performance.

cards.title: Start with a campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Redlands campus
cards.notes: Use the university’s virtual tour or arrange a guided campus tour to get bearings and identify the buildings you will use most often.
cards.short_summary: Begin by learning the 160-acre Redlands campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: The university offers a virtual tour and guided campus tours led by Bulldog ambassadors on its Redlands campus.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Guided tours require scheduling through the university; use the virtual tour anytime.

cards.title: Pause at Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · north end of the Quad
cards.notes: Walk to the chapel, note the Chaplain’s Office location, and check its calendar before planning worship, talks, or other hosted programs.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus focal point with voluntary worship services.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Chapel was dedicated in 1928 at the north end of the Quad, and the Chaplain’s Office is located within it.
cards.access_notes: Building access and event participation can vary; confirm with the Chaplain’s Office or event listing.

cards.title: Make the Quad your meetup point
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · beside Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: Choose the Quad as an easy outdoor meeting point for a short reset, then use it to orient yourself between Chapel and nearby campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus space beside Memorial Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Quad as an outdoor space next to Memorial Chapel and suitable for picnics and fairs.
cards.source_title: Memorial Chapel and University Quad | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Use the space respectfully and yield to any scheduled university event.

cards.title: See what is on at the Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Colton Avenue and West Drive
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, then visit the Gallery Building on the corner of Colton Avenue and West Drive while campus is active.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery presenting student, faculty, and local artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Gallery is in the Gallery Building at the corner of Colton Avenue and West Drive and lists current and past exhibitions.
cards.source_title: University Art Gallery | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Verify exhibition dates and gallery access before going.

cards.title: Settle into Armacost Library
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Redlands campus
cards.notes: Find a study space, ask about research help, and save the library as a calm return point once classes and new-campus logistics begin.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with study spaces and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Armacost Library offers study spaces, interlibrary loans, and personalized research consultations.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Find an involvement lead
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Hunsaker University Center, second floor
cards.notes: Stop by the Student Leadership Lab and use the active-club information to identify one low-commitment meeting, activity, or group to try.
cards.short_summary: A campus contact point for clubs and student involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Leadership Lab is on the second floor of Hunsaker University Center, and the university directs students there for club involvement.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Confirm office availability and club meeting times before making a special trip.

cards.title: Take the campus shuttle downtown
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · pickup at Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: Bring your valid U of R ID, board at Memorial Chapel, and use the tracked shuttle route for a simple first trip to the downtown district.
cards.short_summary: A student shuttle connects campus with downtown and shopping areas.
cards.evidence_claim: When classes are in session, the university’s free student shuttle runs Thursday through Sunday and serves the downtown Redlands district; its campus stop is at Memorial Chapel.
cards.source_title: University Shuttle Services | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: A valid University of Redlands ID is required. The listed Thursday–Sunday service runs 5:00–10:00 p.m. while classes are in session.

cards.title: Browse A.K. Smiley Public Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · 125 W. Vine St., Redlands
cards.notes: Use the downtown stop to browse the historic library, then check its calendar for public programs that fit the rest of your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A historic public library with collections, programs, and weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: A.K. Smiley Public Library is housed in its original historic building and lists Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday hours of 1–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend hours are Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; confirm holiday changes before travel.

cards.title: Take a Sunday garden walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime · 1325 Prospect Drive, Redlands
cards.notes: Visit the estate grounds for a self-guided garden walk; wear comfortable shoes and use handrails carefully on the garden’s stairs and uneven terrain.
cards.short_summary: Historic estate grounds open for a free self-guided visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Kimberly Crest’s estate grounds are regularly open Monday–Friday and Sunday from 10 a.m.–4 p.m. with no charge.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are listed as open Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; the property is closed Saturdays for private events. House tours require tickets.

cards.title: Close with a Redlands Bowl performance
cards.subtitle: Friday evening in summer · 25 Grant St., Redlands
cards.notes: If your first weekend falls during the summer season, bring a friend to a listed program and arrive ready for an 8 p.m. outdoor performance.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor performing-arts program with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Redlands Bowl Summer Music Festival holds performances at 8:00 p.m. on Tuesdays and Fridays, with no admission charge or ticket reservation required.
cards.source_title: Show | Redlands Bowl Summer Music Festival
cards.access_notes: Seasonal program: the official site lists Tuesday and Friday concerts at 8:00 p.m.; check the current schedule before going.
